high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the official Twitter account of Randhir Jaiswal (@MEAIndia), which is verified. The tweet announces that National Security Advisor (NSA) Ajit Doval met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing. The discussion focused on bilateral, regional, and international issues of mutual interest. Text Content: The tweet reads: "NSA Ajit Doval met Chinese FM Wang Yi in Beijing. Discussions focussed on bilateral, regional & international issues of mutual interest." Below the main text, there is a link to a press release
